question: Which of the following cities of Delhi was founded by Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tughluqabad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tughluqabad** was founded by Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq, the founder of the Tughlaq dynasty, in 1321.
 
• It is one of the seven historical cities of Delhi and was built to serve as the third city of Delhi.
 
• The fort of Tughluqabad was constructed with the intention of providing a strong defense against Mongol invasions.
 
• The city is known for its massive fortifications and architectural grandeur.
 
• Tughluqabad served as the capital of the Tughlaq dynasty during Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq's reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq, also known as Ghazi Malik, was the founder and first ruler of the Tughlaq dynasty in India.
 
• He ruled from 1320 to 1325 and was known for his administrative reforms and efforts to strengthen the central government.
 
• Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq's reign marked the beginning of a new architectural style that combined Indo-Islamic elements.
 
• The Tughlaq dynasty is known for its significant contributions to the architectural heritage of India, including the construction of forts, mosques, and other structures.
